data.action: 倚在浴桶内的长凳上，一手持羽毛停在锁骨旁。
data.camera: side view, medium shot, horizontal framing
data.description: 雪松浴桶内，拉菲艾拉穿白色吊带上衣倚在水下长凳上，一根羽毛停在锁骨旁。暖光透过薄薄水汽，在木质桶沿与水面留下柔和反光。
data.lighting: warm steamy ambient glow, glistening water reflections
data.promptProse: La Pluma traces a feather along her collarbone while touching herself underwater, resting on the submerged bench. Warm light passes through thin steam and reflects softly on the cedar rim and water.
data.title: 羽毛笔 · 氤氲私汤
